name: Feature request

## Problem

What user problem or operational gap does this address? Who is affected
(role, district, scale)? What is the cost of the status quo?

## Proposed solution

Describe what you want, at the level of user experience or platform
capability. Avoid prescribing implementation in this section.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you think about, and why is this one preferred?

## Configurability vs. code

UAMP's promise is that new awards launch without code. Does this require:

- [ ] New schema field type in the Form Engine
- [ ] New workflow stage type
- [ ] New evaluation rubric primitive
- [ ] New report
- [ ] Pure admin configuration (no code needed)

## Success criteria

How will we know this is shipped and working? Include measurable signals
(SLA, adoption %, error rate, time saved).

## Risks / open questions
